user.title: Connect to Privs
user.description: Name this Home Assistant as it should appear in the Privs app. Next you'll get a code to approve in the app.

data_description.name: Shown in Privs under Settings > Home Assistant, so you can tell installs apart.

expired.title: Code expired
expired.description: Codes last 10 minutes. Submit to get a new one.

failed.title: Lost connection
failed.description: Home Assistant couldn't reach Privs while waiting for approval. Submit to try again with a new code.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} is no longer connected to Privs. It was disconnected in the app, or its session was lost. Submit to get a new code to approve.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Privs. Check the connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This pairing is already set up.

disconnected.message: This install was disconnected in the Privs app.

session_expired.message: The connection to Privs was lost. Pair again.

locked.message: Locked for today after three strikes.

not_delegated.message: This person is no longer shared with Home Assistant.

read_only.message: This install can view but not change points. To allow changes, disconnect it in Privs under Settings > Home Assistant and pair again with View and Change Points.

outside_session.message: Points can't be changed outside the session times.

rate_limited.message: Too many changes in the last minute. Try again shortly.

change_points.name: Change points
change_points.description: Gains or loses a point, or sends someone straight to the bottom, with an optional note for their history.

note.name: Note
note.description: Shown in the person's history in Privs.
